{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion issues
print(sales_df['revenue'].isna().sum())  # Should be 0 if all are valid

# Now inspect the 'status' column to see what values exist
print(sales_df['status'].unique())"}
